name: aera-monorepo
description: AERA — AI Spatial Design & Interior Planning Platform (Full-Stack Monorepo)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
